A Realistic Comparison: NAFTA vs the TPP

tl;dr The TPP looks to be a lot like the failed NAFTA in that:

  • It was promised to create new jobs in America
  • Actually moved jobs from the U.S. to other countries
  • Failed to account for the vastly cheaper production because of a lack of environmental/labor regulation
  • Eventually the U.S. imports more than it exports

Then there is one difference that makes it worse: it's classified to the majority of Americans and government workers. Former Secretary of Labor Robert Reich (who worked under the Clinton Administration and knew well of NAFTA) was asked by a few congressman on his advice on the TPP. He wasn't even allowed to read it.
